title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運~Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation
focus: 整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面~Integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces
summary: 本課以整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面為主線，從預製體積與結構質量與排水體積與浮力平衡建立系統邊界，再把吃水變化與水線面、預製溫度與節段變形連到浮運放行與資料一致性。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces. It begins with Fabrication volume and structural mass and Displacement and buoyancy balance, links Draft change and waterplane area and Fabrication temperature and segment deformation, and ends with Flotation release and record consistency. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 預製體積與結構質量~Fabrication volume and structural mass
units.title: 預製體積與結構質量~Fabrication volume and structural mass
units.mechanism: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。公噸是質量而非力，受力計算還需重力加速度；材料密度與實際幾何誤差應分開追蹤，才可判斷預測吃水差異來源。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity. Track density and geometry errors separately to diagnose differences between predicted and observed draft. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量~Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
units.practice: 將把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 排水體積與浮力平衡~Displacement and buoyancy balance
units.title: 排水體積與浮力平衡~Displacement and buoyancy balance
units.mechanism: 靜浮時浮力等於總重量，所需排水體積由總質量除水密度得到。海水密度隨鹽度和溫度變化，內部進水還會同時改變質量與自由液面；平衡只說明垂直合力，不保證遇擾動後會回復原姿態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡；若出現沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~At static flotation buoyancy balances total weight, giving displacement as mass divided by water density. Salinity and temperature change density, while internal flooding changes mass and free surfaces. Vertical balance alone does not establish restoration after a disturbance or a safe marine operation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger. If incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 重心與初始橫向穩性~Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability
units.title: 重心與初始橫向穩性~Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability
units.mechanism: 初始穩性取決於重心、浮心與水線面幾何，不只是總浮力。小角度穩心高只描述平衡附近斜率，大角度扶正力臂仍需獨立分析；臨時設備放高或壓載分布不當，可能在總重量不變時明顯改變穩性。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據；若出現質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Initial stability depends on gravity centre, buoyancy centre and waterplane geometry rather than total buoyancy alone. Small-angle metacentric height describes the local restoring slope; large-angle arms require separate analysis. High equipment or altered ballast can change stability without changing total mass. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. If raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 自由液面與穩性折減~Free surfaces and stability reduction
units.title: 自由液面與穩性折減~Free surfaces and stability reduction
units.mechanism: 未滿的壓載艙液體會隨傾斜移動，產生減少扶正能力的自由液面效應。其影響取決於液面面積慣性矩而非僅水量，寬而淺的艙可能比窄艙更敏感；隔艙和液位狀態需要在每個浮運階段明確列示。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性；若出現只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Liquid in partially filled tanks shifts with heel and reduces restoring action through free-surface effects. The effect depends on liquid-surface second moment rather than volume alone; broad shallow tanks can be especially sensitive. Define compartments and fill state at every flotation stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. If crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 吃水變化與水線面~Draft change and waterplane area
units.title: 吃水變化與水線面~Draft change and waterplane area
units.mechanism: 小幅增重的吃水變化可用新增質量除水密度和水線面積估算，但水線面隨吃水變化時需重新計算。縱向質量位置還會造成俯仰，不應把平均吃水套到每個角落；測量須同時辨認平均下沉和姿態變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化；若出現平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Small added mass changes mean draft according to density and waterplane area, provided area remains approximately constant. Longitudinal mass position also changes trim, so average draft cannot represent every corner. Distinguish mean immersion from pitch and roll in the survey. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry. If acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 臨時封艙與水壓合力~Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant
units.title: 臨時封艙與水壓合力~Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant
units.mechanism: 封艙在浮運期間承受內外水位差，合力與壓力沿高度的分布有關，不能只用底部壓力乘整面積。支承、接頭與滲漏會影響局部受力，還須考慮不同艙室狀態；船體浮力平衡不會自動證明封艙強度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄；若出現以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Bulkheads resist internal-external head differences with a pressure distribution over depth, not bottom pressure uniformly over the area. Supports, joints and leakage affect local response across compartment states. Global flotation balance does not establish bulkhead strength or connection integrity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together. units.anchor: 預製溫度與節段變形~Fabrication temperature and segment deformation

units.anchor: 水流阻力與拖航界面~Current drag and tow interface

A simple formula estimates quasi-static action only; waves, acceleration and towline dynamics require marine analysis. One drag figure is not a complete towing-system or weather-window design. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. If ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 支承轉換與縱向彎曲~Support transitions and longitudinal bending
units.title: 支承轉換與縱向彎曲~Support transitions and longitudinal bending
units.mechanism: 管節從預製支座到浮力分布，再到沉放和基床接觸，縱向支承條件多次改變。相同自重在不同分布反力下產生不同彎矩，浮體波浪彎曲也不能用陸上簡支模型替代；每一階段需有自己的荷載及接觸假設。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將支座、浮力分布及基床接觸分別連到管節應變資料；若出現借用上一階段支承模型，漏掉轉換時的最大縱向彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Support changes from fabrication bearings to distributed buoyancy and then immersion and bedding contact. Equal weight produces different moments under different reactions, and wave bending is not a land-based simple beam. Each stage needs its own loading and contact assumptions with verified transitions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate bearing, buoyancy and bedding contact states separately to element strains. If reusing a previous support model misses peak longitudinal bending during transfer, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 浮運放行與資料一致性~Flotation release and record consistency
units.title: 浮運放行與資料一致性~Flotation release and record consistency
units.mechanism: 浮運判斷需要質量、幾何、水密、穩性及設備狀態的共同版本，單項合格不能互相抵消。晚期設備變更可能改變重心和吃水，若未更新計算就使原結論失效；交接應能追溯每項輸入的日期與實際配置。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對最後配置與質量、穩性、水密及幾何文件版本；若出現設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Release requires consistent versions of mass, geometry, tightness, stability and equipment status; passing one cannot offset failure of another. Late equipment changes alter gravity and draft and can invalidate earlier conclusions. Trace each input to its date and installed configuration rather than a generic certificate. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit final configuration against mass, stability, tightness and geometry document revisions. If equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查預製體積與結構質量：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t；再獨立檢查排水體積與浮力平衡：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。結構質量由 60000 增為 63000 t，海水密度 1.025 t/m3，平衡排水體積由 58536.6 增為 61463.4 m3；質量增加 5% 不代表穩性也改善 5%。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 將比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. Independently check Displacement and buoyancy balance: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3. Mass rising from 60000 to 63000 t at seawater density 1.025 t/m3 increases displacement from 58536.6 to 61463.4 m3; five percent more mass does not imply five percent better stability. The two results are not a complete design because buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Use compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。費馬恩業主公開工廠、溝槽與管節施工脈絡，深中通道則列於密封製造商案例；兩者僅作工法與界面比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Femern describes factory, trench and element interfaces, while the seal manufacturer lists the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. They are method and interface comparisons only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
